00.text: After defeating the golem and Sweat the door is now unguarded.

sweat_killed_0.name: Sour
sweat_killed_0.text: It's time to complete your quest lumberer.

sweat_killed_1.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_1.text: Aren't you a little bit sad that I just destroyed your friend.

sweat_killed_2.name: Sour
sweat_killed_2.text: Don't worry. You just destroyed their physical shell. Once they regain enough power they'll be as good as new.

sweat_killed_3.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_3.text: You walk over to the door and knock on it three times.

sweat_killed_4.text: WHO DARES INTERUPT ME AS I SIT ON MY THRONE.

sweat_killed_5.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_5.text: It is I lord Pasta. The humble lumberjack that you chose to undertake your most valiant quest.

sweat_killed_6.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_6.text: Ahh. The lumberjack. I have awaited your arrival for some time now. Thank you Sour for helping guide the lumberjack. I assume you were most helpful. However I do not see Sweat where are they?

dailog_0.name: Lord Pasta
dailog_0.text: Ahh. The lumberjack. I have awaited your arrival for some time now. Thank you Sweat for helping guide the lumberjack. I assume you were most helpful. However I do not see Sour where are they?

dailog_1.name: Lord Pasta
dailog_1.text: Ahh. The lumberjack. I have awaited your arrival for some time now. Thank you Sweat and Sour for helping guide the lumberjack. I assume you were both most helpful. And I trust you still carry the relic lumberjack.

sweat_killed_7.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_7.text: They.. uhhh. They had to attend to other business.

sweat_killed_8.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_8.text: Very well. I trust you still carry the relic.

sweat_killed_11.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_11.text: You place your hand on the lid of the chest. You can barely hold your anticipation as you open it.

sweat_killed_12.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_12.text: You stare into the open chest at the relic in disbalief.

sweat_killed_13.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_13.text: A roll of bogroll sits inside the chest.

sweat_killed_14.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_14.text: Before you have the time to process what your looking at the door in front of you opens revealing a stench you could not imagine in your worst nightmares and from this stench a large hand reaches out from the door and grabs the bogroll from the chest.

sweat_killed_15.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_15.text: I cannot thank you enough mortal. To think today was just a normal day before I felt the turtle poking it's head out the shell, let's just say it was touching cloth. Even a lord like myself must perform their duty from time to time but in my haste to perform this duty I forgot that I had not restocked my supply of bogroll and so I sent for you lumberjack to deliver to me this most sacred relic in my time of need and for that I am grateful.

sweat_killed_16.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_16.text: Uhh... don't mention it. I only helped cause I was told I would be rewared.

sweat_killed_17.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_17.text: Ah of course. I have the perfect reward for your performance.

sweat_killed_18.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_18.text: For you I gift this party hat. So that the party never ends.

sweat_killed_19.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_19.text: For you I gift this rune axe. So you can chop down any tree.

sweat_killed_20.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_20.text: For you I gift this blue magicians hat. So you can look cool while casting spells or what not.

sweat_killed_22.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_22.text: Nice. Always wanted one of those.

sweat_killed_24.name: Lord Pasta
sweat_killed_24.text: Now leave me lumberjack for I have important business to attend to.

sweat_killed_25.name: Narrator
sweat_killed_25.text: As you turn around you find yourself completely alone.

sweat_killed_26.name: Lumberjack
sweat_killed_26.text: Wait how am I suppost to get home?

sour_killed_0.text: After defeating the golem and Sour the door is now unguarded.

sour_killed_1.text: It's time mortal complete the quest.

sour_killed_3.text: Don't worry. You just destroyed their physical shell. Once they regain enough power they'll be as good as new.
